purpose: Trade-level concentration audit of the R131 dual-sleeve candidate and paper-trading readiness.

decision.reason: Parity failed for both sleeves; R131 cannot be reproduced on current factor data.

caveats: Attribution uses monthly risk-parity weights and monthly vol-target exposures at trade entry.
A/B sleeves were independently backtested with 1M starting capital; weighting is an approximation.
Industry classification is the current snapshot, not historical PIT.
R131 return is concentrated in 2023-2026; 2018-2022 was weak.
Paper trading is not production deployment.

b_pit_parity.purpose: Check whether the B sleeve re-run with PIT Shenwan industry reproduces the r119 cache.
b_pit_parity.note: The B sleeve was re-run after rebuilding PIT Shenwan industry data; ext_data was restored in a finally block.

parity_conclusion: A 腿缓存 +91.06% vs 当前重跑 +63.34%；B 腿缓存 +39.04% vs 当前快照重跑 -29.55%，即使重建 PIT 申万行业也只有 -41.16%。两袖均无法复现，说明当前因子数据版本与 R131 验证时的数据快照不一致。在恢复或冻结数据快照之前，R131 的 +64.5%/MDD -15.7% 结论不能被当作可复现的部署依据。
concentration_scope_note: The concentration numbers above describe the current-data re-run, not the validated R131 candidate. They show the current-data A/B combination is even more concentrated (top1 40.9%, top3 87.1%, top5 120.2%).
recommended_next_step: Freeze or restore the exact alt_hs300 and alt_market_regime factor snapshots used by R131, rerun the audit, and only then consider paper trading. Do not deploy the current-data variant: it loses money on the B sleeve and fails C2-C4.
